title: A Geometric Theory of Cosmological Structure via Entropic Curvature in Wasserstein Space
summary: We construct a geometric framework for cosmological large-scale structure based on optimal transport theory and Wasserstein geometry. In this framework, Ricci curvature on the probability measure space $\mathcal{P}_2(M)$ is characterized by the geodesic convexity of entropy and is formulated as the response of probability distributions to optimal transport.
